title: Kling 3.0 Motion Control Standard
summary: Motion control with Kling 3.0 Motion Control Standard
description: Kling 3.0 motion control (standard tier) — transfers the motion from a reference video onto a character image. Priced per second of the reference video (91 credits/second).

character_orientation.description: Take the character's orientation from the reference video or from the image. With "image", the reference video must be 10 seconds or less.

image.description: Character image to animate. A public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. jpg/png/webp (a webp is converted), at least 340px on each side, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.

keep_original_sound.description: Keep the original audio from the reference video.

prompt.default: Replace the characters in the video with the characters from the image, while strictly maintaining the characters' movements.
prompt.description: How the character should be animated.

video.description: Motion reference video whose movement drives the character. A public video URL or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. mp4/mov, 3-30 seconds (max 10 seconds when character_orientation is "image"), up to 30 MB.
